summary: Full backend + frontend regression of CLA Aesthetics redesign. 28/28 backend pytest tests pass (auth, removed endpoints, leads lifecycle, analytics track+stats, blog CRUD, CMS CRUD for 5 kinds, uploads, offers, content, SMTP). Frontend flows verified: dark black/gold homepage renders, no 'Ask Camille' widget, nav Home/About/Services/Portfolio/Blog/Reviews/Contact present, Inquire button visible, footer PYTECH credit link (target=_blank, correct href) and Admin link work, gallery marquee present. Inquiry form submission succeeds and inquiry appears in admin. Admin login redirects to /admin dashboard; all stat cards (views, visitors, inquiries, gallery, blog), traffic-chart and range 7/30/90 present. Sidebar navigation confirmed for Inquiries, Blog (create post w/ markdown works), Media (YouTube link added successfully; upload button present), Offers, Treatments (correct path /admin/treatments -> admin-cms-treatments_menu + cms-add), Content, Settings (smtp-save + change-password-form). Blog post page renders title+body. Legal /privacy /terms render in dark theme. Unknown routes redirect to /. Mobile viewport shows nav-mobile-toggle -> mnav-link-*, mobile-book-bar with call and inquire buttons. All test artifacts cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1367 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, cms, blog, offers, uploads, analytics) for maintainability.
startup() still creates an index on legacy db.chat_messages though /api/chat has been removed; safe but stale.
DEFAULT_CONTENT for privacy/terms/cookies/refund still references removed Stripe/membership/portal/Camille flows in the copy — mismatch with product decisions (may confuse readers).

Admin sidebar route for Treatments uses /admin/treatments while task description referenced /admin/cms/treatments_menu — actual data-testid `admin-cms-treatments_menu` still matches spec; not a bug but worth noting for consistency.
/api/admin/settings/smtp/test raises 500 wrapping the SMTP error message — consider 400 for enabled-but-misconfigured; currently returns 400 when disabled which matches spec.
Storage-served /api/uploads/{path} depends on remote object store — no local fallback; add graceful 503 already handled which is fine.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted: TEST_UI User & TEST_Playwright User leads, TEST_UI_Post blog, YouTube gallery item, TEST_* CMS items. Test values remain: test.key=TEST_VALUE in content (harmless test key).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py under /app/backend/tests is the fresh regression suite (uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Treatments admin page is at /admin/treatments (not /admin/cms/treatments_menu). Media page uses /admin/media. All data-testids match spec.
